method: Read each completed originating section in full canonical Hebrew and each listed target paragraph in full, with additional surrounding context where required. Examined candidates from both schools for every completed subsection and assessed specific argumentative relevance. Selected exact contiguous quotations and translated them against the Hebrew; no retrieval score grants approval. This file records only the finite comparisons actually completed, not every possible parallel. Section and paragraph pins preserve the reviewed context. Independent second-reader corrections are incorporated before publication. Chanukah 8 was completed in the resumed work and independently reviewed in full; the separate independent-review proof records its complete candidate comparison and bilingual corrections. English presentation was then normalized without square brackets while preserving all clarification and source-aside content.
